newsitem.title: UK: Bunzl sees H1 broadly in line with yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Bunzl sees H1 broadly in line with yr-ago.

text.p: British paper and plastics group Bunzl Plc said on Wednesday that as a result of sterling's strength and lower paper prices, it expects its first half results to be broadly similar to the same period last year.

Bunzl said the strength of sterling, particularly in the early months of the year, will impact on the group's results, although the effect is largely one of translation. Its overseas profits will be reported in sterling.
Meanwhile, paper prices remain lower in the first quarter of this year compared to the same period in 1996.

"On current expectations, these two factors will result in the first half, excluding any positive impact from the sale of discontinued operations, being broadly similar to that of last year," chairman Anthony Habgood told the annual general meeting.
He added that for the year as a whole the group is expected to progress satisfactorily through its strategy of building its businesses through organic growth and acquisitions.
